title: Cancellation Charge Schedule for Kessler GAP Waivers
content:
# Cancellation Charge Schedule for Kessler GAP Waivers

Fee schedule of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda for a holder's cancellation refunded on the unused part of the term. The charge depends on two facts from the records: the reason the holder stated on the signed cancellation request (customer request or deal unwound), and the waiver's whole months in force from the sale date to the request date the holder signed.

## Schedule

| Months in force at signing | Stated reason: customer request | Any other stated reason |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | No cancellation charge | Tier cancellation fee |
| 12 to 23 | 25.00 | Tier cancellation fee |
| Fewer than 12 | Tier cancellation fee | Tier cancellation fee |

The tier cancellation fee is 50.00 on Kessler GAP Waiver 125, Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140, Kessler GAP Waiver 150, Kessler GAP Plus 150 and Kessler GAP Plus 175, and 75.00 on Kessler GAP Commercial 130.

The cancellation charge is deducted from the refund after the unused-share amount has been rounded half up to the cent.

## Months in force

A whole calendar month counts each time the sale date's day of the month is reached; a signing date on an earlier day of the month does not complete the month, and there is no month-end adjustment.

## Boundary points (hypothetical)

- A customer-request cancellation signed on the day the 24th month completes carries no charge; signed the day before, it is in its 12-to-23 band and carries 25.00.
- A customer-request cancellation signed on the day the 12th month completes carries 25.00; the day before, it carries the tier fee.
- A request stating the reason deal unwound carries the tier fee at every age.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a long-held waiver cancelled on the customer's own request pay a fee?** Not once it has been in force 24 or more months.

**What does a Kessler GAP Commercial 130 holder pay on a customer-request cancellation 15 months in?** 25.00; the 75.00 tier fee applies only outside the customer-request bands of 12 months or more.
